τῆλε: τῆλε — far, far away; adv., also + gen.: ’far from’

ἀνστάντες: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; intrans. aor. part. masc. nom. pl., epic apocope (ἀνστάντες = ἀναστάντες)

ἀφέηκε: ἀφίημι — let go, release; aor. 3 sg., epic ἀφέηκε (= Attic ἀφῆκε): ’let go’
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’you Achaeans’
ἀχιλλεύς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus, chief Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.

ἄεθλον: ἄεθλον — contest, prize (epic; = Attic ἆθλον); neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg. (same form), subject: τόδε φαίνετ’ ἄεθλον ’this contest appears’
ἄειρε: ἀείρω (= αἴρω) — lift, raise, bring; pres. imper. 2 sg. act., epic uncontracted: ’lift, bring’ · also impf. 3 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic ᾖρε): ’lifted’ (ἄειρε δὲ ποιμένα λαῶν ’and lifted the shepherd of the people’)
ἄλλοισι: ἄλλος — other; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις) · also neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι, agreeing with κτεάτεσσιν: ’the other (possessions)’
ἄνακτι: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. dat. sg.
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄνδρε: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. dual: ’two men’ · also masc. acc. dual: ’two men’ (τοιώδ’ ἄνδρε κατακτείνας ’having killed two such men’)

ἄπο: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (νεῶν ἄπο ’from the ships’) · also adv. or preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb: ’off’ (ἄπο … νίζοντες ’washing off’)
ἄπυρον: ἄπυρος — unfired, not put to the fire; adj. of two endings, masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λέβητα

ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρηος: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄρηος (= Attic Ἄρεως) · also by metonymy ’war’ (ἔριδα Ἄρηος ’the strife of war’)
ἄριστος: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος ’best’; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἅ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’which things’ · also neut. acc. pl., inner object with ἅ τε: ’such things as’ (ἅ τε … ὀαρίζετον ’such talk as … hold’)

ἑκάτερθεν: ἑκάτερθε(ν) — on each side, from each side; adv.

ἑξείης: ἑξείης — in order, one after another; adv. (Attic ἑξῆς)

ἔειπεν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 3 sg., epic augmented (ἔ-ειπεν, = Attic εἶπεν)
ἔνδοθι: ἔνδοθι — within, inside; adv., with the locative suffix -θι
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἔνθ’ ἄρα τε φρένες ἔρχαται ’where the midriff is shut’)
ἔντεα: ἔντεα — gear, implements, equipment; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’the gear’ (ἔντεα κεῖται ’the gear lies’)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπεφνε: φένω (aor. ἔπεφνον) — slay; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aorist

ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’ · also ’holding, possessing’, of a lord and his land (Πήδασον ἔχων ’holding Pedasus’)
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε) · also aor. 3 sg. in battle: ’killed’ (Σχεδίον … ἕλε ’killed Schedius’) · also in tmesis (διὰ … ἕλε = διεῖλε): ’tore through’ (διὰ δ’ ἀμφοτέρους ἕλε κύκλους ’tore through both rings’)

ἕταροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl., epic by-form ἕταροι (= ἑταῖροι)

ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἤϊξε: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented ἤϊ- (= Attic ᾖξε): ’darted’
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg. · also masc. voc. sg., a courteous address: ’hero!’
ἥρωϊ: ἥρως — hero, warrior; masc. dat. sg., epic -ϊ (= Attic ἥρῳ)

ἰὸν: ἰός — arrow; masc. acc. sg. (a different word from ἰός ’poison, rust’) · also εἶμι — go; pres. part. neut. nom. sg. (= ἰόν): ’going’
ἱστὸν: ἱστός — loom, mast; masc. acc. sg. (here ’loom’, and by extension the web on it) · also ’mast’ (of a ship): ἱστὸν … στῆσαν ἀείραντες ’they raised and set up the mast’
ἴδμεν: οἶδα — know; pres. 1 pl., epic ἴδμεν (= Attic ἴσμεν): ’we know’
ἴθυνεν: ἰθύνω — make straight, guide, direct; aor. 3 sg.: ’guided’
ἵκανεν: ἱκάνω — come to, reach; impf. 3 sg., ν-movable: ’came to’
ἵσταντο: ἵστημι — set, place; mid. impf. 3 pl., intransitive: ’took their stand, were standing’
ἶσ: ἴσος — equal, like; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially, elided (ἶσ’ = ἶσα), + dat.: ’equally with’ · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἀέθλια: ’equal (prizes)’
ὀρεξάμενος: ὀρέγομαι — reach out, thrust at; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., + acc.: ’thrusting at’
ὀρθὸς: ὀρθός — upright, straight; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’upright’
ὀϊστὸν: ὀϊστός — arrow; masc. acc. sg. (= Attic ὀιστόν)
ὁμίλου: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. gen. sg.
ὁρμήθησαν: ὁρμάω — set in motion; pass. rush, start; aor. 3 pl. pass. in active sense, + inf.: ’they rushed’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄζος: ὄζος — branch, shoot; fig. scion, offshoot; masc. nom. sg.
ὄρνυσθ: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rouse oneself, rise; pres. imper. 2 pl. mid., elided (ὄρνυσθ’ = ὄρνυσθε): ’rouse yourselves’
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of perceiving: ’that’ (οὐδ’ ἐνόησεν ὅ … ’did not perceive that …’)
ὅσον: ὅσος — as much as, as many as, as far as; neut. acc. sg., adverbial: ’as far as’ · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial, of measure: ’about as much as’ (ὅσον τ’ ὄργυι’ ’about a fathom’)
ὅσσον: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος) — as much/great as; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’how much, how far’ · also correlative with τόσσον: ’as much as’ (τόσσον … ὅσσον)
ὅσσόν: ὅσος — as great as, as much as; neut. acc. sg., epic ὅσσον (= Attic ὅσον), adverbial before τε: ’as loud as’ · also ’as far as’ (ὅσσόν τ’ ἐπὶ οὖρα πέλονται ’as far as the furrow-lengths extend’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also ὡς ὅτε, introducing a simile: ’as when’
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + gen.: ’on behalf of’ (ὑπὲρ Δαναῶν) · also + acc., ’beyond’ (ὑπὲρ αἶσαν ’beyond due measure’) · also + gen. of place, ’above’ (στέρνον ὑπὲρ μαζοῖο ’the breast above the nipple’) · also + acc. of motion, ’over’ (ὑπὲρ ὦμον ’over the shoulder’) · also + gen., ’about, concerning’ (ὑπὲρ σέθεν αἴσχε’ ἀκούω ’I hear shameful things about you’) · also + gen., of entreaty: ’by’ (λίσσομ’ ὑπὲρ ψυχῆς ’I beseech by your life’) · also + gen. of place: ’beyond, across’ (ὑπὲρ ποταμοῖο ’across the river’)
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’) · also prep. + acc., place where: ’beneath’ (ὑπὸ γαῖαν ’beneath the earth’) · also prep. + φι-form of place: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ ζυγόφι ’from under the yoke’)
ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’) · also ὡς ὅτε, ’as when’, introducing a simile · also introducing a wish with the optative alone: ’would that’ (ὡς ἔρις … ἀπόλοιτο ’would that strife perish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom./acc. dual (= Attic ὥ): ’the two whom’
ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’rushed, started up’ · also of a sound, aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’arose’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥέξειν: ῥέζω — do, perform, sacrifice; fut. inf. act., in a vow after εὔχεο or εὔχετο: ’(vow) to sacrifice’ · also fut. inf. act., after ἔολπα: ’(I expect you) will do’ · also fut. inf. act., in a prayer after ἠρήσατο: ’(prayed) to sacrifice’
